metadata.question: Are there more than three lakes within a 50 km radius of coordinates (35.879797, 86.428836) in Augest 11, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect water bodies (lakes) around coordinates (35.879797, 86.428836) - Date: August 11, 2024 - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8/9 for water detection - Create a 50 km radius buffer around the point - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to identify water bodies 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clean water detection - Use water index threshold (NDWI > 0 or MNDWI > 0) to identify water - Need to count distinct water bodies (connected components) 3. Logic: - If no images found → C1 - If no valid pixels after masking → C2 - If calculation fails or result is invalid → C3 - If lakes > 3 → A (Yes) - If lakes ≤ 3 → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([86.428836, 35.879797]); const radius = 50000; // 50 km in meters const roi = point.buffer(radius); const startDate = '2024-08-01'; const endDate = '2024-08-20'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(roi) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); let size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 9 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(roi) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 9 images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No images found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Create water mask const image = collection.median().clip(roi); // Calculate MNDWI for water detection let waterIndex; if (collection.first().bandNames().contains('B3').getInfo()) { // Sentinel-2: MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) waterIndex = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); } else { // Landsat: MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1) waterIndex = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); } const waterMask = waterIndex.gt(0.1); // Water threshold // 4. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid water pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected.'); console.log('B'); return; } // 5. Count distinct water bodies using connected components const waterBodies = waterMask.selfMask(); const connected = waterBodies.connectedComponents({ connectedness: ee.Kernel.square(1), maxSize: 256 }); // Get unique labels (each represents a separate water body) const labels = connected.select('labels'); const uniqueLabels = labels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('labels').getInfo(); console.log(`Number of distinct water bodies detected: ${uniqueLabels}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (uniqueLabels === null || uniqueLabels === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); } else if (uniqueLabels > 3) { console.log('More than 3 lakes detected.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('3 or fewer lakes detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
